title: NURO finding things on the seafloor
summary: John Harrington tells of NURO finding things on the seafloor, about present at Ocean floor, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> It seems like they might be finding things on the seafloor. >> Yep. They are

plain: John Harrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, was asked on Jesse Michels's podcast about NURO, a little-known secret office said to handle underwater reconnaissance. When it was put to him that they might be finding things on the seafloor, he answered, "Yep. They are." If true, it would mean a hidden government effort is recovering unexplained objects from the ocean floor.
